ruleDefinitions.name: Modify Group Policy Settings - ScriptBlockLogging
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect malicious GPO modifications can be used to implement many other malicious behaviors. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\System.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTimeDC.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffsetDC.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTime.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffset.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*EnableSmartScreen.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ShellSmartScreenLevel.*")))
